title: Inherited constant-section linear structure on integral constructible objects
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with ring of integers $R$, and a scheme $Y$ in the same universe as $E$. On completed-coefficient module morphisms use multiplication by the canonical constant section $c_Y(a)$ for $a\in R$, and on the ambient derived category use the induced scalar action characterized by localization. Define the $R$-linear structure on the full intrinsic constructible category $D^b_c(Y,R)$ by restricting precisely these ambient Hom modules: for a morphism $f:K\to L$, its scalar multiple is the full-subcategory morphism with underlying map $a\cdot f$. Composition and identities are those of the ambient full subcategory, and composition is bilinear for this action. This is the inherited linear structure, not a second choice of scalar action; no assertion about the linearity of an additional functor is included.

Constructions used: [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-sf-completed-integral-scalar-action], [def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction].
